description:
The value lists for filtering - legal forms, size classes - and, with a query word,
        the matching OENACE sectors with the exact nace_* filter to use. Read-only.

        Parameters:
        - query (optional): a category word (e.g. "Brauerei", "software"); returns ``matches``
          with each sector's level, code, label and the nace_* filter value for search_companies.
          Omitted: the legal-form and size-class value lists with counts.

        Served from the Austrian backend; the industry codes are OENACE == WZ == NACE Rev. 2,
        identical for both countries, so a resolved code also filters the German register. The
        value lists and counts themselves are Austrian (a notice says so). It returns no company
        data - call it once up front to resolve a filter value.
name: list_sectors
title: List sectors & value lists (AT)
